{{CharInfobox |color={{platinum color}} |corecolor={{platinum color light}} |bordercolor={{platinum color dark}} |name=Jeremiah |jname=ウブカタ |tmname=Ubukata |slogan=no |image=Jeremiah.png |size=270px |caption=Jeremiah |gender=Male |hometown=[[Jubilife City]] |region=[[Sinnoh]] |trainer=no |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=DP126 |epname=Classroom Training! |enva=[[Tom Wayland]] |java=[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]] }} '''Jeremiah''' (Japanese: '''ウブカタ''' ''Ubukata'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is a sales representative working for the [[Pokétch Company]] in [[Jubilife City]]. Jeremiah was inspired by his customers to become a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and now attends [[Snowpoint City]]'s {{pkmn|academy|Trainers' School}}. ==History== In his debut in ''[[DP126|Classroom Training!]]'', Jeremiah took a test in which he answered all of [[Candice]]'s riddle-style questions correctly while {{Ash}} impatiently answered them, resulting in the wrong answers. Because of this, Jeremiah thought Ash was not a truly skilled {{pkmn|Trainer}}, and only won his [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s by luck. After the test, he tried to take back the [[Poké Ball]]s stolen by {{TRT}}. He called on his {{p|Skuntank}} for assistance, but [[James's Carnivine]] used {{m|Vine Whip}} to incapacitate Skuntank. Ash and the others stepped in and successfully defeated Team Rocket, and upon realizing that Ash was a competent Trainer, he apologized to Ash. In ''[[DP127|Sliding Into Seventh!]]'', Jeremiah was left in charge of a class of younger students while Ash and Candice had their Gym match. When Team Rocket attempted to steal the school's Poké Balls for a second time, he used his Skuntank's {{a|Stench}} [[Ability]] to chase Team Rocket away. Jeremiah made a brief cameo in ''[[DP177|A Grand Fight for Winning!]]'', where he watched the [[Contest Battle]] between {{an|Dawn}} and [[Zoey]] in the final round of the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] in the Snowpoint Trainers' School, alongside Candice. ==Character== Jeremiah is responsible and composed in his manner. He initially considered himself an expert [[Pokémon Trainer]] because of his rigorous studying. However, he later learned that he was lacking the practical experience showcased by {{Ash}} when he took on {{TRT}} in ''[[DP126|Classroom Training!]]''. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Jeremiah's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jeremiah |pkmn=Skuntank |type1=Poison |type2=Dark |img=Jeremiah Skuntank.png |epnum=DP126 |epname=Classroom Training! |vajp=Kenta Miyake |vaen=Kenta Miyake |desc=Jeremiah's {{p|Skuntank}} first appeared in ''[[DP126|Classroom Training]]'', where Jeremiah explained that after working in [[Jubilife City]] most of his life he decided to begin a {{pkmn|journey}} and chose Skuntank as his [[first partner Pokémon]]. Later it battled [[James's Carnivine]] and was about to be defeated when it was saved by {{AP|Pikachu}}. It reappeared in ''[[DP127|Sliding Into Seventh!]]'' when Jeremiah used its Stench Ability to force Team Rocket out of hiding in a shed, and recover the school's stolen Pokémon. Skuntank's known moves are {{m|Scratch}}{{tt|*|It was unable to use the move.}} and {{m|Night Slash}}{{tt|*|It was unable to use the move.}}, and its Ability is {{a|Stench}}{{tt|*|Used off-screen.}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{platinum color}}|bordercolor={{platinum color light}} |ja=阪口大助 ''[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] |fi=Antti Timonen |no=Tommy Karlsen |es_eu=Juan Amador Pulido |cs=Vojtěch Hájek |pt_br=Luiz Antônio Lobue |pl=Waldemar Barwiński|fr_eu=Tony Beck}}
